cpu:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single square macOS app icon concept for Lookout, a system monitoring app. This is preview concept A.
Primary request: a CPU microchip placed at a jaunty diagonal, with a rising bar graph overlaid at its upper right.
Subject and composition: one chunky square CPU chip in a gentle three-quarter isometric view, rotated diagonally about 25 degrees. The chip has a clear central processor plate and a small number of broad readable connector pins along its edges. Exactly three thick rounded vertical bars of ascending height overlap the chip in the upper-right quadrant, rising above its top-right edge. Keep the chip recognizable and the bars distinct; compose the two as one balanced app-icon symbol.
Style: polished comic illustration with bold smooth outlines, rounded shapes, playful slight exaggeration, crisp simple shading and a little dimensional depth. Professional and charming, very legible at small app-icon sizes.
Backdrop: clean softly rounded-square app tile on a plain light surrounding canvas, with generous safe margins. Minimal backdrop, no scene.
Constraints: one icon only, no presentation board, no multiple options. No lettering, no CPU text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark. No extra graph axes, arrows, badges or decorative objects. Keep the artwork centered and uncropped. Square 1024x1024 composition.
telescope:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single square macOS app icon concept for Lookout, a system monitoring app. This is preview concept B.
Primary request: express the meaning of Lookout through a telescope / eye silhouette subtly combined with a chart, in a comical style.
Subject and composition: one compact chunky handheld telescope in a jaunty three-quarter view, with a large front lens that reads as one curious friendly eye. A short telescoping barrel gives it an unmistakable telescope silhouette. The three simple glossy reflections inside the eye-like lens form three small bars of ascending height: an understated monitoring-chart detail integrated into the lens itself, not a separate floating graph. A gently lifted single brow formed by the upper lens rim and the tilted barrel create a witty watchful expression. Keep the telescope and eye as one cohesive symbol.
Style: polished comic illustration, bold smooth contours, rounded shapes, expressive but simple, clean shaded color planes with restrained dimensional depth. Charming app-icon design with a strong silhouette at small sizes. The lens and telescope dominate; the chart is a subtle discovery.
Backdrop: clean softly rounded-square app tile on a plain light surrounding canvas, with generous safe margins. Minimal backdrop, no scene.
Constraints: one icon only, no presentation board, no multiple options. No lettering, no name, no numbers, no labels, no watermark. No person, hands, limbs, stars, tripod, extra eyes, or decorative objects. Avoid realistic eyeball anatomy or a surveillance-camera appearance. Keep the artwork centered and uncropped. Square 1024x1024 composition.
